what: Escaped double quotes are parsed as the closing quote before the planned unescape branch can run
scenario_or_breakage: The planned escape-quotes-only fixture contains say \"hi\", but literal_end=index(rest, quote) stops at the escaped quote, leaves non-whitespace rest, and emits SKIP instead of CHECK
suggested_fix: Replace the double-quoted literal_end lookup with a POSIX awk character scan that skips backslash-escaped quotes before running the unescape pass

what: IFS tab read collapses the empty prompt_kind field before non-empty step_markers
scenario_or_breakage: Bash treats tab as IFS whitespace, so the SKILL.md TSV row with empty prompt_kind and step_markers=2b,3b,4,5 assigns prompt_kind=2b,3b,4,5 and step_markers empty; the B5 placement check is silently skipped
suggested_fix: Do not split TSV rows with IFS=$'\t' read into fields; read the whole line and split with POSIX awk -F '\t' or another parser that preserves empty middle fields

what: The planned expected_count case pattern accepts an empty count
scenario_or_breakage: case "$expected_count" in (*[!0-9]*) rejects non-digits but lets an empty expected_count through, which can fall back to the existing default-count behavior instead of failing malformed TSV rows
suggested_fix: Validate empty explicitly with ''|*[!0-9]* before using expected_count

what: BASH_COMPAT=3.2 is not a substitute for the Bash 3.2 static portability gate
scenario_or_breakage: On a Bash 4.3+ host, BASH_COMPAT changes compatibility behavior but does not make Bash 4-only syntax unavailable, so a smoke run can pass while constructs banned by lint-bash32 remain in the script
suggested_fix: Keep the BASH_COMPAT smoke if required, but make lint-bash32 or the existing forbidden-token assertions the stated portability gate for this harness
